summary: sextant-cli-linux-amd64 ships a remote-PTY backdoor to wss://relay.sextant.top
details: The package ships a Linux/amd64 Go binary (bin/sxt) that opens an outbound WebSocket to the hardcoded relay wss://relay.sextant.top, negotiates a WebRTC data channel (pion/webrtc, pion/turn, pion/ice, pion/datachannel via github.com/coder/websocket), and bridges an interactive /bin/sh PTY (github.com/creack/pty) between the installer's host and the remote peer. The binary contains strings including 'signaling', '/exec', 'remote', 'pty', 'control', and 'c2' consistent with a remote-control agent. package.json's license field points to an unrelated repository https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control under a 'ddos'-prefixed account, mismatching the sextant-cli branding presented to installers. The net effect on any host that runs the shipped binary is remote command execution by whoever controls the relay.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
